title: Generation of non-human primate CAR Tregs using artificial antigen-presenting cells
author: Ellis, Deng, et al.

steps.title: Centrifuge blood to separate plasma
steps.instruction: Dispense anti‑coagulated blood into a 50 mL conical tube and spin at 650 g for 10 min at room temperature with deceleration and acceleration set to the lowest speed to avoid disrupting the plasma layer.

steps.title: Remove plasma layer
steps.instruction: Pipette off the clear upper plasma layer, leaving the RBC/PBMC‑enriched layer behind.

steps.title: Dilute RBC/PBMC layer
steps.instruction: Add one volume of PBS to the remaining RBC/PBMC layer and mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare 60 % Percoll cushion
steps.instruction: Place 15 mL of room‑temperature 60 % Percoll solution into a fresh 50 mL conical tube, avoiding contact of Percoll with the tube walls.

steps.title: Overlay blood onto Percoll
steps.instruction: Slowly overlay up to 35 mL of the diluted blood on top of the Percoll solution.

steps.title: Centrifuge gradient
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube for 30 min at 650 g with deceleration and acceleration set to the lowest speed.

steps.title: Remove top layer
steps.instruction: Pipette off the top layer until approximately 2.5 cm above the interphase.

steps.title: Collect PBMC interface
steps.instruction: Using a pipette, collect the hazy middle layer that contains the PBMCs and transfer it to a new tube.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Fill a new 50 mL conical tube with PBS to dilute the collected cells.

steps.title: Wash by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin the tube at 650 g for 10 min, this time setting deceleration and acceleration to their highest settings.

steps.title: Lyse residual red blood cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL ACK lysis buffer, then fill the tube to 50 mL with ACK buffer, rock gently for 8 min at room temperature, and spin again for 10 min at 650 g. Do not exceed 8 min of lysis; if cellular debris appears, filter the sample through a 70 µm filter into a new 50 mL conical tube before the final centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 1 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Add ACK buffer to a final volume of 50 mL.
Rock gently for 8 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend cells for sorting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final cell pellet in 300 µL flow cytometry buffer and transfer to a sterile FACS tube.

description: The following protocol describes the expansion and transduction of CAR Tregs recognizing the NHP/human alloantigen Bw6 with CD28 and CD3ζ intracellular signaling domains. This protocol can be easily adapted to generate CAR Tregs with other specificities or to generate effector CAR T cells. Here, we describe the protocol for Cynomolgus macaque, but we have also generated CAR T cells from Rhesus macaque with equal success. Before starting, generate aliquots of simian tropic χHIV lentiviral vectors, irradiated K562 artificial antigen presenting cells (aAPCs), and NHP α-CD3/α-CD28 beads to have on hand.
